lines: בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃ הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־מַלְאָכָיו הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־צְבָאָיו׃
הַלְלֽוּהוּ שֶֽׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵֽחַ הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־כּֽוֹכְבֵי אוֹר׃ הַלְלֽוּהוּ
שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָֽיִם וְהַמַּֽיִם אֲשֶׁר מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־
שֵׁם יְהֹוָה כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃ וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם
חָק־נָתַן וְלֹא־יַעֲבוֹר׃ הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ תַּנִּינִים
וְכָל־תְּהֹמוֹת׃ אֵשׁ וּבָרָד שֶֽׁלֶג וְקִטוֹר רֽוּחַ סְעָרָה עֹשָׂה
דְבָרוֹ׃ הֶהָרִים וְכָל־גְּבָעוֹת עֵץ פְּרִי וְכָל־אֲרָזִים׃ הַחַיָּה
וְכָל־בְּהֵמָה רֶֽמֶשׂ וְצִפּוֹר כָּנָף׃ מַלְכֵי־אֶֽרֶץ וְכָל־לְאֻמִּים
שָׂרִים וְכָל־שֹֽׁפְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃ בַּחוּרִים וְגַם־בְּתוּלוֹת זְקֵנִים
עִם־נְעָרִים׃ יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהֹוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ
הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶֽרֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃ וַיָּֽרֶם קֶֽרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־
חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרֹבוֹ הַלְלוּיָהּ׃
blocks.text: בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃ הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־מַלְאָכָיו הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־צְבָאָיו׃ הַלְלֽוּהוּ שֶֽׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵֽחַ הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־כּֽוֹכְבֵי אוֹר׃ הַלְלֽוּהוּ שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָֽיִם וְהַמַּֽיִם אֲשֶׁר מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהֹוָה כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃ וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חָק־נָתַן וְלֹא־יַעֲבוֹר׃ הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ תַּנִּינִים וְכָל־תְּהֹמוֹת׃ אֵשׁ וּבָרָד שֶֽׁלֶג וְקִטוֹר רֽוּחַ סְעָרָה עֹשָׂה דְבָרוֹ׃ הֶהָרִים וְכָל־גְּבָעוֹת עֵץ פְּרִי וְכָל־אֲרָזִים׃ הַחַיָּה וְכָל־בְּהֵמָה רֶֽמֶשׂ וְצִפּוֹר כָּנָף׃ מַלְכֵי־אֶֽרֶץ וְכָל־לְאֻמִּים שָׂרִים וְכָל־שֹֽׁפְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃ בַּחוּרִים וְגַם־בְּתוּלוֹת זְקֵנִים עִם־נְעָרִים׃ יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהֹוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶֽרֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃ וַיָּֽרֶם קֶֽרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרֹבוֹ הַלְלוּיָהּ׃

lines: הַלְלוּיָהּ שִֽׁירוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל
חֲסִידִים׃ יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִֽילוּ בְמַלְכָּם׃
יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃ כִּי־רוֹצֶה
יְהֹוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָה׃ יַעְלְזוּ חֲסִידִים
בְּכָבוֹד יְרַנְּנוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם׃ רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם
וְחֶֽרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת בְּיָדָם׃ לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בַּגּוֹיִם תּוֹכֵחוֹת
בַּלְאֻמִּים׃ לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי
בַרְזֶל׃ לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל־
חֲסִידָיו הַלְלוּיָהּ׃
blocks.text: הַלְלוּיָהּ שִֽׁירוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל חֲסִידִים׃ יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִֽילוּ בְמַלְכָּם׃ יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃ כִּי־רוֹצֶה יְהֹוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָה׃ יַעְלְזוּ חֲסִידִים בְּכָבוֹד יְרַנְּנוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם׃ רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם וְחֶֽרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת בְּיָדָם׃ לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בַּגּוֹיִם תּוֹכֵחוֹת בַּלְאֻמִּים׃ לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל׃ לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו הַלְלוּיָהּ׃

praise Him all stars of light. Praise Him, O highest heavens,
O water above the heavens. Let them praise the Name of the
Lord for He commanded and they were created. He estab-
lished them for ever, for eternity, He gave a decree that will
not pass. Praise the Lord from the earth, dragons and all the
depths. Fire and hail, snow and smoke, the whirlwind obeys
His order, the mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all
cedars, the wild beast and all cattle, reptiles and winged
birds, earthly kings and all nations, princes and all earthly
judges, youths as well as maidens, old men with young lads.
Let them praise the Name of the Lord for His Name alone
is exalted. His majesty is above earth and heaven. He has
raised the condition of His people, there is fame for all His
pious ones, for the children of Israel, the people near Him,
Halleluyah.

lines: Halleluyah. Sing unto the Lord a new song,
His fame is in the gathering of the pious. Israel rejoices in
its Maker, the sons of Zion exult in their King. Let them
praise His Name with dancing, with timbrel and harp let them
play to Him. For the Lord favours His people, He adorns the
humble with victory. The pious revel in honour, they exult
upon their couches. Exaltations of God are in their throat
and a two-edged sword in their hand, so as to carry out
vengeance among the nations, chastisements among the peo-
ples, to bind their kings in fetters and their notables in chains
of iron, to execute on them the judgment that is written. He
is an adornment to all His pious ones. Halleluyah.
blocks.text: Halleluyah. Sing unto the Lord a new song, His fame is in the gathering of the pious. Israel rejoices in its Maker, the sons of Zion exult in their King. The pious revel in honour, they exult upon their couches. Exaltations of God are in their throat and a two-edged sword in their hand, so as to carry out vengeance among the nations, chastisements among the peoples, to bind their kings in fetters and their notables in chains of iron, to execute on them the judgment that is written. He is an adornment to all His pious ones. Halleluyah.

lines: Halleluyah. Praise God in His sanctuary,
praise Him in His strong firmament. Praise Him for His
mighty deeds, praise Him according to the abundance of His
greatness. Praise Him with the Shofar’s blast, praise Him
with zither and harp, Praise Him with timbrel and dance,

lines: וַיְבָֽרֶךְ דָּוִיד אֶת־יְיָ לְעֵינֵי כָּל־הַקָּהָל וַיֹּֽאמֶר דָּוִיד
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִֽינוּ מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד
עוֹלָם׃ לְךָ יְיָ הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶֽרֶת וְהַנֵּֽצַח
וְהַהוֹד כִּי־כֹל בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ לְךָ יְיָ הַמַּמְלָכָה
וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ׃ וְהָעֹֽשֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ
וְאַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בַּכֹּל וּבְיָדְךָ כֹּֽחַ וּגְבוּרָה וּבְיָדְךָ לְגַדֵּל

lines: And David blessed the Lord before
the eyes of the whole assembly and David said: Blessed art

eternity, Thine, O Lord, is greatness and might, glory and
victory and majesty; with regard to all in heaven and on

art ruler over all and in Thy hand is strength and might and
it is in Thy hand to make all great and strong. And now, our
God, we give thanks to Thee and praise Thy glorious Name.

lines: Then did Moses sing together with the Children of
Israel this song to the Lord and those are the words: I will
sing to the Lord for He is truly exalted, the steed and its
rider has He flung into the sea. My strength and song is the
Lord and He was my salvation, this is my God that I may
glorify Him, my father’s God that I may exalt Him. The
Lord is a warrior, His name is the Lord. Pharaoh’s chariot
and army did He throw into the sea and the finest of his
captains were sunk in the Sea of Reeds. The depths cover
them, they went down to the bottom like a stone. Thy right
hand, O Lord, is wonderful in strength, Thy right hand O
Lord shatters the enemy. And in the abundance of Thy
grandeur dost Thou destroy Thy foes, when Thou sendest
forth Thine anger, it consumes them like stubble. And
through the breath of Thy nostrils are the waters heaped
up, flowing waters stand up like a mound, the depths congeal
in the heart of the sea. The enemy thought, I will pursue,

coverage_limits: Only the identified scans and their enlargements were consulted. No other transcription or edition was compared.
All visible source lines are represented. Uncertain glyph identities or placements are provisional, especially adjacent detached points or fine strokes in Hebrew.

In the chant, lines retain the visible brick layout approximately through a three-space separator. Hebrew verse-ending vertical marks are encoded with U+05BD. English block text joins typesetting hyphenation, while lines retain the wraps.
